visible.title: --global.disableWatchdogWarning deprecated in production.
visible.body:
### Checklist

### Summary

I get the following error when I deploy my streamlit app which works locally to posit connect.
```
streamlit.errors.DeprecationError:
════════════════════════════════════════════════
global.disableWatchdogWarning IS NO LONGER SUPPORTED.

global.disableWatchdogWarning has been deprecated and will be removed in a future version.

Please update command-line argument or environment variable.
════════════════════════════════════════════════
```

This exception is still affecting me with version 1.37 of streamlit being deployed on posit connect. None of the recommendations in other forums helped. Can you please tell me how to fix this? I dont have a terminal in posit and cannot change the command that is used to run the streamlit app. I can define environment variables or create a config.toml file though.

gold.summary: Deprecation error for global.disableWatchdogWarning when deploying to Posit Connect.
hypotheses: option set in config.toml/env/CLI by the user
set by the hosting platform's launch command

missing_info.item: where the option could be set (config.toml, STREAMLIT_GLOBAL_DISABLE_WATCHDOG_WARNING env var, CLI)

acceptable_next_steps: Tell user to remove the option from config/env/CLI
If absent, the platform sets it -> contact Posit
gold.reference: Maintainer: remove option; if not set by you, Posit Connect likely sets it.
